title: Setting up for a mosaic class
titleZh: 準備馬賽克拼貼課材料

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: For this morning’s mosaic class, each tray needs a brush and a packet of blue tiles. Did the trays arrive?
turns.zh: 今天早上的馬賽克課，每個材料盤需要一支刷子和一包藍色磁磚。盤子到了嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, on the counter. All trays have brushes, but I’m one packet of blue tiles short.
turns.zh: 到了，在櫃檯上。每盤都有刷子，但還缺一包藍色磁磚。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: There’s one in the cupboard. Once you add it, put the empty carton under the counter.
turns.zh: 櫃子裡有一包。補上後，把空紙箱放到櫃檯下。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I’ll put the finished trays out ten minutes before class.
turns.zh: 我會在開課前十分鐘把備妥的材料盤擺好。
